Your SmartTube home-screen rows (Subscriptions, Recommended, History), mirrored for Projectivy Launcher, with every video opening in **TizenTube Cobalt**.

**Install:** see the [README](https://github.com/1OO1O11O/tuberows#install). A one-time ADB setup is required (install, grant one permission, battery exemption).

**Requires:** Android TV / Google TV 8.0+, TizenTube Cobalt, SmartTube (signed in, Channels service on), and a launcher that shows app channels, such as Projectivy Launcher.

**In this release**
- Subscriptions and Recommended rows (History optional), up to 40 videos each
- Watch Next: up to 3 of your most recent History videos (Continue) and up to 5 new subscription uploads (New)
- Keeps SmartTube's data fresh: refresh 2 minutes after you open a video, when you open the app, and hourly while the screen is on; never more than once per 10 minutes on its own
- Status screen with row toggles, last refresh, and power exemption status
- No internet permission: the app never contacts any server
